verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs name this workflow directly: "Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix" (cursor-docs-3). Cloud agents can build, test, start dev servers, click through UI flows and verify their changes work, then attach screenshots, videos and log references to the PR as proof of the fix. Service-account docs describe a Sentry error triggering an agent to investigate and fix it, and the SDK cookbook ships bug-triage workers. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on root-cause narrowing (the dedicated page is only a heading), specifics on how issues are reproduced locally, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the debugging workflow.
